title: Ecology federal permits record: Watson Pier, Float and Ramp (Aquatics 142091)

licence.text: Use allowed with credit and a link; commercial and political use prohibited

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Remove the existing 510-square foot solid decking float with eight 15-inch diameter creosote piles. Construct a new joint-use 6-foot by 120-foot fully grade pier, 4-foot by 48-foot fully grated aluminum ramp, and an 8-foot by 60-foot float (60% open space). Six 10-inch-diameter steel piles supporting the pier and ramp and two 10-inch-diameter steel piles supporting the float with three Sea-Flex anchor systems with three Duckbill embedded anchors to secure the float depth of greater than -20 MLLW, and two 4-inch diameter galvanized steel pin piles and associated 6 feet transition plate (from the end of the pier to top of bank).
